turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hi Karan, thanks for meeting me in person. How are deliveries going for your brand?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Honestly, not great. Our return to origin rate is almost twenty two percent.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That is high. Which courier are you using right now?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mostly Delhivery, and some orders through Shiprocket.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: With ShipFast, we verify the address on WhatsApp before dispatch, which usually brings returns below ten percent.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Interesting. What do you charge per shipment?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Forty five rupees for the first five hundred grams, within the same zone.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We ship about three thousand orders a month, mostly to tier two cities.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: At that volume, I can offer forty rupees, and a free pilot for the first two weeks.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let us start the pilot from the first of December.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect. I will share the onboarding checklist by Friday.
